zh.principle: **标准**：键控散列消息认证码（FIPS 198-1）（The Keyed-Hash Message Authentication Code (HMAC)）。摘要给出对象定义：「This Standard describes a keyed-hash message authentication code (HMAC), a mechanism for message authentication using cryptographic hash functions.」摘要再补一句用途条件——「HMAC can be used with any iterative Approved cryptographic hash function, in combination with a shared secret key.」
zh.why: 为什么要 MAC 构造：标准把目标写成「The purpose of a MAC is to authenticate both the source of a message and its integrity without the use of any additional mechanisms.」并说明 HMAC 的两个参数彼此功能独立——「HMACs have two functionally distinct parameters, a message input and a secret key known only to the message originator and intended receiver(s).」
zh.used: 使用形态按发送方计算、随消息送出：「An HMAC function is used by the message sender to produce a value (the MAC) that is formed by condensing the secret key and the message input.」标准还点名另一类用法——「Additional applications of keyed-hash functions include their use in challenge-response identification protocols for computing responses, which are a function of both a secret key and a challenge message.」
zh.broken: 边界来自联邦口径：适用范围只到「This Standard is applicable to all Federal departments and agencies for the protection of sensitive unclassified information that is not subject to Title 10 United States Code Section 2315 (10 USC 2315) and that is not within a national security system as defined in Title 44 United States Code Section 3502(2) (44 USC 3502(2)).」同段另一句又把采用面放大：「The adoption and use of this Standard is available to private and commercial organizations.」，实现还须只用已批准件——§9「HMAC implementations that comply with this Standard shall employ cryptographic algorithms, cryptographic key generation algorithms and key management techniques that have been approved for protecting Federal government sensitive information.」密钥只有发信方与预期收信方知道，这既是特性也是运维负担。
zh.history: 版本与身份写在文首：名称行「The Keyed-Hash Message Authentication Code (HMAC) (FIPS PUB 198-1)」，日期行为 2008 年 7 月，类别为「Computer Security Standard.Subcategory.Cryptography.」关键词栏列出「computer security, cryptography, HMAC, MAC, message authentication, Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS)」；本标准是 198 号的修订版，编号 -1 即其身份标记。§9 把批准功能清单指向「the list of Approved security functions for FIPS 140-2」，说明它的批准口径仍锚定在 FIPS 140-2 一代，而本语料库中的 FIPS 140-3 已宣告完全取代 140-2。

en.principle: **Standard**: The Keyed-Hash Message Authentication Code (HMAC) (键控散列消息认证码（FIPS 198-1）). The abstract defines the object: "This Standard describes a keyed-hash message authentication code (HMAC), a mechanism for message authentication using cryptographic hash functions." The abstract also gives the operating condition — "HMAC can be used with any iterative Approved cryptographic hash function, in combination with a shared secret key."
en.why: Why a MAC construction: the standard states the goal as "The purpose of a MAC is to authenticate both the source of a message and its integrity without the use of any additional mechanisms." and notes that HMAC has two functionally separate inputs — "HMACs have two functionally distinct parameters, a message input and a secret key known only to the message originator and intended receiver(s)."
en.used: The usage shape is sender-computed and sent with the message: "An HMAC function is used by the message sender to produce a value (the MAC) that is formed by condensing the secret key and the message input." The standard also names another application — "Additional applications of keyed-hash functions include their use in challenge-response identification protocols for computing responses, which are a function of both a secret key and a challenge message.".
en.broken: The boundary is set by sources, versions and implementation conditions: unregistered dates, quantities and roles are not filled in; parameters from different versions are not mixed; algorithm proofs do not replace side-channel and error-handling checks.
en.history: Identity and dating are at the head: the name line reads "The Keyed-Hash Message Authentication Code (HMAC) (FIPS PUB 198-1)", the date line is July 2008 and the category line "Computer Security Standard. Subcategory. Cryptography." Keywords listed are "computer security, cryptography, HMAC, MAC, message authentication, Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS)"; the -1 suffix marks this as the revision of FIPS 198, and clause 9 still points at "the list of Approved security functions for FIPS 140-2" — an anchoring in the FIPS 140-2 generation that FIPS 140-3 later supersedes in its entirety.

zh: HMAC：以密钥化哈希构造的 MAC。
iterative Approved hash function：可与之组合的批准迭代哈希。
shared secret key：收发双方共有的密钥。
challenge-response：用 keyed-hash 计算响应的鉴别流程。
unclassified information：本标准覆盖的非涉密信息，但不含 10 USC 2315 所指信息与国家安全系统。
en: HMAC: the keyed-hash construction of a MAC.
Iterative Approved hash function: an approved hash it may be combined with.
Shared secret key: the key held by both sender and receiver.
Challenge-response: authentication flow computing responses with a keyed hash.
Unclassified information: the scope here, excluding 10 USC 2315 information and national security systems.
